name: Casino Blackjack
author: Addicting Games
description: Casino Blackjack is a casino game for you to play without fear of losing real money! Enter a digital casino where the chips are fake but the game is still fun to play. Each game starts you off with a certain number of chips for you to get started. Just because the risk is not real, you have to play the game with effort in order to get through all the levels. There are 5 levels of this card game, and each level has a certain goal you must reach in order to advance to the next one. Use your chips wisely but do take risks when you think you have a good hand. Playing safe will only get you so far! Submit your score to see if you are a high scorer!
